basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Consultant I, Consultant II Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) is engaging 3 Consultants on contract for the Office of Dean (Faculty)/ Faculty Recruitment Cell/ Establishment-I Section: 1 Consultant-I and 2 Consultant-II. Applications go by email to [email protected] and must be mailed by 1 December 2026; no hard copy is to be sent by post or courier. The advertisement number is Rectt./34/2026(W), dated 11 November 2026.

qualification.details: The engagement is on a purely contract basis for a period of 01 year. It can be extended up to a maximum of 02 more years, subject to requirement and after review of satisfactory work performance based on functional need. The engagement position is described as Type-III. | Qualification: MBA in HR with at least 55% marks. Experience: at least 10 years in handling day-to-day HR/administrative activities including recruitment process, Data Analytics, Report Preparation, MIS data handling etc. Age limit: below 45 years. Pay: Rs.50,000/- to Rs.1,00,000/- per month; minimum monthly remuneration of Rs.50,000/- for the selected candidate. | Qualification: Master's Degree in any discipline. Experience: at least 05 years of relevant experience in establishment matters including recruitment, office procedures, noting & drafting, pay-fixation, data management etc. Age limit: below 40 years. Pay: Rs.40,000/- to Rs.75,000/- per month; minimum monthly remuneration of Rs.40,000/- for the selected candidate. | The cut-off date for determining age, experience and educational qualification is 01.12.2026. The notice does not list any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for any further detail on eligibility for each post.

selection_process: IIT Delhi will conduct a shortlisting-based interview. Applications received within the due date are shortlisted by a Committee
and only shortlisted candidates are considered for further selection.
The essential qualifications and experience are minimum
and possessing them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. If the number of applications is large
the Institute reserves the right to adopt a shortlisting criteria to restrict the number of eligible candidates called. The decision of the Committee is final and binding.
The date of the selection process will be communicated separately by email to provisionally shortlisted candidates only. The notice does not state a date or venue.
important_instructions: This is purely a temporary engagement. Appearing in the interview and selection does not give any claim to permanency on the regular establishment of IIT Delhi. An immediate joinee will be preferred. The Institute reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies, or to postpone or cancel the recruitment for any or all of the positions, without assigning any reason. If any information is found false or incorrect at any stage, the candidature or appointment is liable to be cancelled.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Consultant-I: Rs.50,000/- to Rs.1,00,000/- per month; Consultant-II: Rs.40,000/- to Rs.75,000/- per month (consolidated)
Consultant-I: MBA in HR with at least 55% marks; Consultant-II: Master's Degree in any discipline
Office of Dean (Faculty)/ Faculty Recruitment Cell/ Establishment-I Section, IIT Delhi
01.12.2026 (application to be mailed by this date)

content_sections.heading: About IIT Delhi
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi is located at Hauz Khas, New Delhi – 110016, and its website is www.iitd.ac.in . This recruitment is issued by its Recruitment Cell. The Consultants will work in the Office of Dean (Faculty)/ Faculty Recruitment Cell/ Establishment-I Section.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications are sent by email to [email protected] by 01.12.2026. The notice does not print a subject line for the email. The notice states there is no need to submit a hard copy through Post/Courier. The prescribed application form is a specimen available on the IIT Delhi website, www.iitd.ac.in , under the link Jobs@IITDelhi, under the heading Non-Academic. The form must carry a recent passport size photograph and be duly filled in by the candidate. Get the prescribed application form from the Jobs@IITDelhi link (heading Non-Academic) on the IIT Delhi website. Fill in the form and affix a recent passport size photograph. Give detailed information about Educational Qualification, indicating the percentage of marks or division obtained in each examination, and details of work experience. Prepare self-attested copies of documents supporting Educational Qualification and Experience in PDF format. All scanned documents should be clearly legible, preferably at a resolution of 300 dpi or higher. Mail the filled form and the documents to [email protected] by 01.12.2026.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The engagement is on a purely contract basis for a period of 01 year. It can be extended up to a maximum of 02 more years, subject to requirement and after review of satisfactory work performance based on functional need. The engagement position is described as Type-III. Qualification: MBA in HR with at least 55% marks. Experience: at least 10 years in handling day-to-day HR/administrative activities including recruitment process, Data Analytics, Report Preparation, MIS data handling etc. Age limit: below 45 years. Pay: Rs.50,000/- to Rs.1,00,000/- per month; minimum monthly remuneration of Rs.50,000/- for the selected candidate. Qualification: Master's Degree in any discipline. Experience: at least 05 years of relevant experience in establishment matters including recruitment, office procedures, noting & drafting, pay-fixation, data management etc. Age limit: below 40 years. Pay: Rs.40,000/- to Rs.75,000/- per month; minimum monthly remuneration of Rs.40,000/- for the selected candidate. The cut-off date for determining age, experience and educational qualification is 01.12.2026. The notice does not list any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for any further detail on eligibility for each post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Prescribed application form with a recent passport size photograph. Self-attested copies of documents supporting Educational Qualification, in PDF format. Self-attested copies of documents supporting Experience, in PDF format. Only complete and duly filled application forms with all supporting documents specified in the form are considered. Incomplete or incorrectly filled forms, or resumes sent in place of the prescribed form, are rejected and not considered for further stages. Original certificates and documents supporting educational qualification (both academic and professional) and work experience must be produced at the time of Written Test/ Interview/Joining, if selected.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: IIT Delhi will conduct a shortlisting-based interview. Applications received within the due date are shortlisted by a Committee, and only shortlisted candidates are considered for further selection. The essential qualifications and experience are minimum, and possessing them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. If the number of applications is large, the Institute reserves the right to adopt a shortlisting criteria to restrict the number of eligible candidates called. The decision of the Committee is final and binding. The date of the selection process will be communicated separately by email to provisionally shortlisted candidates only. The notice does not state a date or venue.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies for Consultants: 1 for Consultant-I and 2 for Consultant-II.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Delhi Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The application form with documents must be mailed by 01.12.2026 to [email protected].

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Consultant-I and Consultant-II at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: Consultant-I needs an MBA in HR with at least 55% marks and at least 10 years' experience in HR/administrative activities. Consultant-II needs a Master's Degree in any discipline and at least 05 years of relevant experience in establishment matters.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIT Delhi Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 45 years for Consultant-I and below 40 years for Consultant-II, counted on the cut-off date of 01.12.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of IIT Delhi Consultants?
faq.answer: Consultant-I gets a consolidated Rs.50,000/- to Rs.1,00,000/- per month, and Consultant-II gets Rs.40,000/- to Rs.75,000/- per month. The minimum monthly remuneration is Rs.50,000/- for Consultant-I and Rs.40,000/- for Consultant-II.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for IIT Delhi Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed application form with a recent passport size photograph, attach self-attested PDF copies of qualification and experience documents, and email them to [email protected]. No hard copy needs to be sent by post or courier.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is by a shortlisting-based interview. A Committee shortlists the applications received by the due date, and only shortlisted candidates are called by email.

faq.question: Q8. Is the IIT Delhi Consultant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a purely temporary contract engagement for 01 year, extendable up to a maximum of 02 more years, and gives no claim to permanency at IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q9. Can the remuneration increase during the contract?
faq.answer: Yes. It may be reviewed after one year, with an annual increment of 03% to 10% subject to performance assessment, up to the upper limit. No increment is admissible if the engagement is at the upper limit.

faq.question: Q10. Will a resume be accepted instead of the application form?
faq.answer: No. Resumes submitted in place of the prescribed application form are rejected and not considered for further stages.
